metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills for empirical economics research (survey/conjoint experiments, literature management).

plugins.name: literature-sync
plugins.description: Convert new paper PDFs in a literature folder to Markdown (via the gemini-pdf skill / Antigravity CLI). Idempotent reconcile: PDFs without a matching .md are converted; existing .md files are skipped; raw PDFs are never modified.

plugins.name: citation-check
plugins.description: Verify every citation and characterization of cited work in a draft against original source text in the reference library, never model memory. Verdicts: SUPPORTED / MISCHARACTERIZED / MISSING SOURCE.

plugins.name: conjoint-amce
plugins.description: Estimate AMCEs and marginal means from long-format conjoint data with respondent-clustered SEs (Hainmueller-Hopkins-Yamamoto 2014; Leeper et al. 2020), tidy tables + forest plot, and reconcile against existing results.

plugins.name: conjoint-diagnostics
plugins.description: Verification gates for conjoint designs before trusting AMCEs: randomization balance, placebo AMCE, profile order, carryover, clustered-vs-robust SE, comprehension robustness. PASS/FLAG report with stop rules.

plugins.name: refine
plugins.description: Referee-style prioritized revision memo for an empirical economics draft, ALWAYS delegated to an independent ChatGPT agent (codex CLI preferred, OpenAI API fallback) -- never written by Claude itself.
